Label: SFX Level
Comment: 0x3 is only used for certain SFX types. Otherwise, you won't get a sound effect at all.

Label: Ground/Air
Description:
0x0 = Unknown, 0x1 = Grounded Only
0x2 = Aerial Only, 0x3 = Grounded/Aerial
Comment:
If 0x80000000 is set to this flag, the hitbox won't hit against downed opponent.
e.g., 0x80000001 deals damage only for grounded opponent isn't laying down.

Label: Type
Comment:
Carryover from Brawl for modifying stats in SE. No water type exists in Smash 4.
Probably no meaning in Smash 4.

Label: Hit Bits
Comment: Controls what kind of targets the hitbox will be able to hit.

Label: Unknown flag
Comment:
0x0 = usual
0x1 for the from-the-front hitboxes of Back Slash and ROB's SpecialS_C3.

Label: Unknown bit
Description:
Another Hit Bits?
If set to 0x1, can't hit to character/enemy/floor/ceiling
but can hit to items/baloons
Comment:
0xf(0b1111) = usual
0xc(0b1100) for banana hitbox
0x9(0b0101) for Master Hand

Label: Unknown flag
Comment: Only Dr. Wright's building hitbox has 0x1.

Label: Rehit Rate
Comment: Determines how many frames need to play before the hitbox can hit again.

Label: No Invincible
Comment:
WFT's Dtilt, Master Hand(0x10BB7180)
(Marth/Lucina's Final Smash had had 0x1 until 1.1.3)

Label: No Intangible
Comment:
Doesn't apply to invinciblility. Jigg's Final Smash, Master Hand(0x10BB7180)
(WFT's Nair had had 0x1 until 1.0.0, Marth/Lucina's Final Smash until 1.1.3)

Label: Friendly Fire
Comment: Only Hydrant's water hitboxes and Crushbomb's detect hitbox has 0x1 in Smash 4.

Label: No Hitlag
Comment: A lot of wind/water hitboxes are set to 0x1.

Label: No GFX
Comment: A lot of wind/water hitboxes are set to 0x1.

Label: Flinchless
Comment: A lot of wind/water hitboxes are set to 0x1.
